audit_findings.title: Historical OE is not on a constant business perimeter
audit_findings.mechanism: Changes the historical OE series, trend anchor, and support for the growth scenarios by mixing earnings from acquired, retained, and divested businesses.
audit_findings.evidence: This is demonstrated by the 13 acquisitions and 23 divestitures that we have completed since 2020.
audit_findings.explanation: The perimeter inconsistency is demonstrated: Trimble completed 13 acquisitions and 23 divestitures since 2020, including the substantial Ag and Mobility removals. Because the $546.1 million anchor is derived from years representing different businesses, it may not measure the earning power of the currently owned operations. The direction and dollar effect cannot be established without pro forma continuing-business OE, but the issue is reasonably capable of changing the anchor and valuation conclusion.
audit_findings.action: Rebuild every historical OE year on the current-business perimeter, removing divested operations and investee results while incorporating stranded costs, transaction taxes, retained supply economics, and acquisitions; then rerun the trend anchor and all scenarios without changing the prescribed methodology.

audit_findings.title: Illiquid stakes are treated as a determinate bridge asset
audit_findings.magnitude: $466.0 million; $1.92 per share; 5.6% of base equity value
audit_findings.mechanism: Potentially overstates the equity bridge because the $466.0 million carrying value of PTx Trimble and Platform Science is added to operating value without realization discounts.
audit_findings.evidence: The fair value was based on unobservable inputs, including discounted cash flow projections, market comparables, and an option pricing model.
audit_findings.explanation: The use of $466.0 million as a determinate bridge amount is demonstrated, while the appropriate discount is unresolved. Even eliminating the entire amount would reduce base value from $34.36 to approximately $32.44 per share and bull value from $40.04 to approximately $38.12. Both remain far below the $59.47 market price, so this issue cannot change the present valuation conclusion, although it changes the reported value estimate.
audit_findings.action: Reconcile the bridge to the filed $212.1 million PTx Trimble and $253.9 million Platform Science balances, value each security with current operating and financing evidence, and rerun the bridge for preferences, warrants, taxes, and illiquidity discounts.

audit_findings.title: Potential tax claims ahead of common equity may be omitted
audit_findings.magnitude: $79.7 million; $0.33 per share; 1.0% of base equity value
audit_findings.mechanism: If the existing uncertain-tax obligation is neither captured in projected OE nor otherwise reflected, it requires a probability-weighted deduction from the equity bridge.
audit_findings.evidence: The total amount of unrecognized tax benefits at the end of 2025 was $ 79.7 million .
audit_findings.explanation: The filed $79.7 million unrecognized-tax-benefit balance is demonstrated, but omission from economic value is unresolved because the record does not show whether its expected cash effect is already captured in OE. A full $79.7 million deduction would reduce base value only from $34.36 to about $34.03 per share, still far below the $59.47 price; therefore it is not material to the current conclusion.
audit_findings.action: Reconcile the latest gross uncertain-tax balance, accrued interest and penalties, expected settlement amounts, and OE treatment; if absent from OE, rerun the bridge using the probability-weighted cash claim.

audit_findings.title: The share ceiling is not demonstrably complete
audit_findings.mechanism: Any omitted economically dilutive options or contingent awards increase the fully diluted share denominator and reduce value per share.
audit_findings.evidence: Potentially dilutive shares of common stock include outstanding stock options, restricted stock units (“RSUs”), contingently issuable shares, and shares to be purchased under our employee stock purchase plan.
audit_findings.explanation: Completeness is unresolved because the supplied denominator does not demonstrate how outstanding options were treated. However, omitted dilution can only lower value per share: the current price is already 48.5% above the $40.04 bull value and 73.1% above the $34.36 base value. Thus additional shares cannot reverse the present conclusion, although their exact effect is unquantified.
audit_findings.action: Obtain the option roll-forward, strikes, remaining terms, contingent-share schedules, and treasury-stock-method calculation; add only incremental shares not already represented in the 243.079848 million denominator and recompute per-share values.

audit_findings.title: Reported figures remain exposed to material control weaknesses
audit_findings.mechanism: Possible classification, timing, or completeness errors could affect latest OE, the historical trend anchor, taxes, shares, or balance-sheet bridge items.
audit_findings.evidence: The Company did not effectively design, implement and operate process-level control activities related to revenue and related accounts, income taxes, and other financial reporting processes.
audit_findings.explanation: The control weakness is demonstrated and persisted through the July 2026 quarter, but no valuation-input error is demonstrated. Management reported no material misstatement for fiscal 2025, and the auditor issued an unqualified financial-statement opinion while separately issuing an adverse controls opinion. Because the weaknesses cover revenue, taxes, IT-dependent information, and other reporting processes, they may affect value, but the record cannot establish the direction or materiality of any misstatement.
audit_findings.action: Manually reconcile FY2026 OE and each July 2026 bridge input to filed statements and footnotes, inspect subsequent corrections or amendments, test information-produced-by-the-company reports, and rerun the valuation if any input changes.

audit_findings.title: Investee earnings may be counted both in OE and in the stake bridge
audit_findings.mechanism: Investee income included in net-income-derived OE is capitalized through the OE anchor while the corresponding investment is also added in the $466.0 million bridge; investee losses have the opposite effect.
audit_findings.evidence: Our proportionate share of income or loss for equity method investments is recorded in income (loss) from equity method investments, net.
audit_findings.explanation: Double counting is possible but not demonstrated because the supplied method confirms only that portfolio interest income was purged, not that all equity-method and measurement-alternative results were removed. Filed equity-method results were income of $28.1 million in 2023, a $48.1 million loss in the omitted 2024 year, a $0.2 million loss in 2025, and $3.4 million of income in the first half of 2026. Their mixed signs and incomplete coverage of the full OE history prevent the record from establishing direction or materiality.
audit_findings.action: Trace every OE year to the income statement and remove all equity-method income or losses, impairments, observable-price adjustments, and investment gains or losses whenever the related stake is included in the bridge; then recompute the trend anchor and scenarios.
